original_test_intent: Read the installed GPU VBIOS version through the approved vendor tool and confirm every target GPU's identity/version displays correctly against the platform reference.
original_method: Verify signed/hashed amdvbflash and stable GPU index-to-physical identity map, run only local `./amdvbflash -v` with an exact argument allowlist, parse complete per-adapter output and compare part/ASIC/VBIOS values to the approved matrix while confirming no write occurred.
manual_activity: GPU firmware owner supplies signed tool and expected per-adapter VBIOS matrix, validates mapping/output and decides verdict.
safety_requirements: Use local controlled session and stable identity map
Stop on unexpected prompt/write/audit or identity mismatch
agent_execution_scope: Preflight tool hash and adapter map
Parse complete adapter/version output and compare reference
Collect audit/post-health without any flash or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its `-v` portion is relevant, but extra `-i` and insecure remote invocation exceed the literal source and widen risk.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only verified local `./amdvbflash -v`, capture process arguments and full output, and compare every mapped adapter with the approved VBIOS matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot and exact `-v` read-only command plus 5/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an exact-argument wrapper that hashes the binary, records adapter identity/output and rejects all program/image/force switches.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes display correctness and non-mutation auditable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No inventory-only alternative or later flash result substitutes for the literal version display.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Tool output indexing may differ after topology change; stable BDF/serial mapping is required.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines authoritative VBIOS per GPU SKU/serial and approved read-only amdvbflash revision.
expected_evidence: Binary signature/hash/version and exact argv/process audit
Proof no image/program/write invocation and no audit error
Post GPU/driver/log health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently requests local read-only version display; DeepSeek's extra inventory command is unnecessary but not authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, reference and mapping are supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Constrains a firmware-capable utility to an auditable exact read-only command and validates every stable-mapped adapter.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same binary can read or irreversibly program firmware, so safety cannot rely on user intent alone; executable hash and exact argv must be evidence. Adapter index 0 is not a stable physical identity across topology changes, and a version line without BDF/serial association can validate the wrong GPU. Complete mapped output prevents both hazards.
